changes: Added DONE milestone closeout snapshot support. The DONE transition now captures a stable milestone-closeout.json from the accepted milestone_status projection before DONE metadata or later main merges can make the live status view stale. Added read-only milestone_closeout reporting plus CLI docs and regression coverage for the real story_advance DONE path.
usage: Use lattice milestone_closeout --storyId=B-xxxx after a story reaches DONE to print the stable closeout table. Use lattice milestone_status --storyId=B-xxxx for the live freshness/status view while work is still moving.
expectedOutcome: When a story advances from TEST to DONE with milestone data, the user can later see the accepted closeout state even if live milestone_status correctly reports stale bindings after metadata or main movement.
actualTranscript: Verified npm --prefix packages/main run build, node packages/main/tests/milestone-status.test.mjs, lattice validate --story=B-bfba, done_required_validate PASS, and done_prepare dryRun reaching only the missing summary blocker before this summary was written.
outcomeDiff: Expected stable DONE closeout artifact and read-only retrieval; actual implementation writes milestone-closeout.json during the DONE transition path and exposes it through milestone_closeout while keeping milestone_status live and diagnostic.
limitations: No production or Authority completion is claimed. milestone_closeout reports the captured DONE snapshot; it does not recompute current freshness or replace milestone_status for active work.
pitfalls: Do not treat milestone_status after DONE as the final accepted closeout proof, because later metadata or main movement can intentionally make the live freshness view stale. Use milestone_closeout for the accepted closure snapshot.
